title: Back Pressure
subtitle: Refuse work you cannot finish in time, so a surge becomes rejected requests instead of a crash
motto: Say no early, or fail late
keyInsight: An unbounded queue turns a surge into memory growth and useless work; a queue sized to the client timeout sheds the excess while everything it accepts is still worth doing.

decisions.title: Count work done for abandoned clients
decisions.description: The sim reports the share of work spent on requests whose client already timed out, because a long queue looks busy while producing nothing useful.
decisions.alternatives: Reporting throughput alone would make a full queue look healthy.

decisions.title: Size the queue from the timeout
decisions.description: The last frame sets the limit to capacity times the client timeout, the largest queue whose every item is still worth serving.
decisions.alternatives: Picking a round number such as 10,000 would ignore how long clients wait.
